our_interpretation: Read this as a forecast about achieving the growth requirement developed earlier in the post, not merely a report of the author's personal uncertainty.
The full post ties the required growth to OpenAI's 2025 revenue target. That supplies a contextual deadline of December 31, 2025.

The post's worked scenario assigns approximately $7.4 billion to consumer Plus subscriptions and $933 million to business subscriptions. Use the approximately $7.4 billion Plus figure as the operational threshold for this product-specific claim.
The post's separate 310% wording is inconsistent with its worked figures. Neither company-wide revenue nor all paid ChatGPT plans can silently replace Plus revenue.
Treat the reference to lack of profit as background, not an added requirement that 2025 subscription growth be profitable.
criteria.support_condition: Comparable realized 2025 ChatGPT Plus revenue falls materially short of the approximately $7.4 billion level used in the post's worked growth scenario.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable realized 2025 ChatGPT Plus revenue reaches or exceeds approximately $7.4 billion.
